s1_netrev: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_netrev_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_netrev_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_aov: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_aov_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_aov_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_margin: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS gross_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_active_cust: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_active_p2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_active_p3: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_gross_rev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gross_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_orders: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fulfilled_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s1_top_customer: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;
s2_shipping_total: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s2_shipping_region: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY o.ship_region ORDER BY total_shipping_fees DESC;
s2_rev_and_ship: WITH rev AS (SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY o.ship_region), ship AS (SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY o.ship_region) SELECT COALESCE(rev.region, ship.region) AS region, rev.net_revenue, ship.total_shipping FROM rev FULL OUTER JOIN ship ON rev.region = ship.region ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;
s2_lines: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fulfilled_order_lines FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s2_ship_pct: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)) / (SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)) AS shipping_pct_of_net_revenue;
s2_avg_line_disc: SELECT AVG(o.shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee_per_order FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3);
s3_refund_total: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds FROM returns r;
s3_refund_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_refunds DESC;
s3_refund_units: SELECT SUM(r.return_qty) AS total_returned_units FROM returns r;
s3_net_of_refunds: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3)) - (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r) AS net_revenue_after_refunds;
s3_refund_rev_by_cat: WITH rev AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY p.category), ref AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category) SELECT COALESCE(rev.category, ref.category) AS category, rev.net_revenue, ref.total_refunds FROM rev FULL OUTER JOIN ref ON rev.category = ref.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;
s5_ship_pct_region: WITH rev AS (SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY o.ship_region), ship AS (SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY o.ship_region) SELECT COALESCE(rev.region, ship.region) AS region, 100.0 * ship.total_shipping / rev.net_revenue AS shipping_pct_of_net_revenue FROM rev FULL OUTER JOIN ship ON rev.region = ship.region ORDER BY shipping_pct_of_net_revenue DESC;

s7_vocab_paidsearch_orders: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_search_fulfilled_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) AND o.channel ILIKE '%paid%search%';

s8_rev_2024: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024;
s8_rev_fy2024: SELECT SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01';
s8_rev_by_month: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts) AS month, SUM(oi.line_total) AS net_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_ts) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_ts) ORDER BY month;
